text:
Maya (growth): Quick heads-up 1 built a compact pricing micro-calculator prototype for the pricing page. Estimates monthly = tokens_per_req * reqs_per_min * minutes_per_day * 30 * $per_1k_tokens. Added a "spike" slider for short bursts. planning a canary + copy/tier name A/B.
Owen (design): looks good. keep inline help only. rename "burst" -> "spike" (users prefer that word).
Priya (product): we need clean overage copy. current: "Short spikes above reserved capacity may incur overage fees at the metered rate." feels fine.
Jules (sales): lead tagging: pricing_microcalc_v3 + variant. If a user submits calc and opens contact form, auto-create lead in SFDC with calc fields and estimated_monthly. High ARR leads flagged.
Luca (analytics): I'll fire GA events: pricing_calc_started, pricing_calc_submitted. Capture spike_multiplier and tier_variant. Persist tier_variant=A|B|control for lift analysis.
Kenji (ops): will add webhook mapping and Segment trait. Also put lead_source=pricing_microcalc_v3 into payload.
Maya (growth): tier name options to test: A: Kickstart / Scale / Enterprise Pro. B: Basic / Team / Enterprise. control: current. Plan: 5% canary 24h to validate events, then 7-day A/B across 50% traffic.
Priya (product): metrics: calculator completion rate, contact CTR, MQL conversion, inbound quality (deal create rate).
Jules (sales): AE playbook: if estimated_monthly > $5k and calc_submitted -> AE ping. I'll post in #sales-inbound.
marketing-bot: Reminder: pricing-microcalc-canary scheduled 2025-09-01T09:00Z.
Maya (growth): Ops checklist: webhook -> SFDC, GA events, Looker dashboard, Segment trait. timeline: copy + wiring today, deploy canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Owen (design): one microcopy ask: shorten the FAQ line about commitments.
Maya (growth): FAQ draft: "Committed plans are billed monthly. Unused reserved units roll over as credits for the next month. Trial credits apply to your first invoice."
Priya (product): good. Luca create Looker tiles for calc start, completion, contact CTR, MQL rate.
Maya (growth): thanks team, moving PR to review. Notifying Ops to create SFDC mapping now.
Kenji (ops): creating webhook and Segment filter. will share mapping in the PR.
